title: ProjectsGitRefRequest
description: DD-118: the original Buzz Desktop create_project_remote_branch/delete_project_remote_branch through BFF. The person's own SERVER identity pushes to the Relay repository named by its 30617 coordinate; Relay pre-receive policy decides. The request carries the Idempotency-Key header; the push is keyed by (repository, ref, old->new) and reconciled from info/refs.

branch.description: CREATE_BRANCH: the new branch. DELETE_BRANCH: the branch to delete.

sourceBranch.description: CREATE_BRANCH only: the original source branch.

expectedCommit.description: CREATE_BRANCH: the source branch head the new branch starts at. DELETE_BRANCH: the branch head being deleted.
